Rajeshwar Kapil Senior Program Manager/Project Manager

Pune | +91-7987133588 | raj.analyst22@gmail.com

Professional Summary: Techno-functional professional with 14+ years of relevant experience in Program management and Project Management within Banking and Financial Services domain. Proven expertise in Program roadmap planning, Leading delivery across large-scale banking digital transformation programs with Stakeholder management, project governance and steering committee reporting, ensuring delivery within scope and schedule. Specialized in Business Digital Transformation Programs and improving business process efficiency by 25–30%, successfully managing multimillion-dollar portfolios, and enhancing customer satisfaction through strategic leadership.

Skills: Functional

Retail Banking, Private Banking, Digital Banking, Investment banking, Capital Markets, Asset Management, Insurance, Credit Risk and Wealth Management Domain

Managerial

Program Management: End-to-End Delivery, Digital Transformation, RAID Reporting, Risk Mitigation, Steering Committee Presentations, Business Cases, Strategic Planning, Investment Prioritization • Stakeholder Management: Executive reporting, Cross-functional alignment, Conflict resolution • AI Strategy Management: AI adoption strategy, KPI definition, value realization, Human in loop workflow

Technical

Tools: JIRA, Confluence, GitLab, MS-Projects, Salesforce CRM • AI/Analytics tool: AWS, MS foundry, PowerBI, AWS Analytics, MS-Excel, ChatGPT, Claude • Modeling /Wireframing: BI Dashboards, MS-Visio, Gliffy, Confluence

Work experience: UBS Bank group/Credit Suisse, Pune (Feb 2023 till date) Role/Designation: Associate Director (Senior Program / Project Manager)

Drove Business Program management of complex multi-million-dollar banking digital transformation • End to End Business Change management for CRM, CLC, onboarding program • Developed business cases, proposals, Program vision and also executed • Led Enterprise scale banking digital transformation programs, achieving on-time delivery rate across complex roadmap involving business teams from across global regions.



Institutionalized a rigorous governance framework, reducing critical program blockers by 40% • Established proactive risk frameworks and embedded KYC/AML compliance , CDD into workflows • Partnered with Compliance, Legal, and Front Office leaders to define scopes and project onboarding • Mentored Business Change teams and coordinated with IT teams for technical delivery • Ensured delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality targets while acting as the single point of accountability for program status and deliverables and effectively managing resource allocation

Major Projects Worked:

CSDA, Digital CRM: UBS/Credit Suisse, Private Banking

Managed Program for CRM/CLM Portal which leverages data analytics to help RM’s to manage client life cycle, due diligence efficiently. Recommendation systems to provide Next best action and BI-dashboards

• COA: Digital Swiss banking, UBS Bank

Managed Business Program for Swiss banking Digital platform for onboarding activities of KYC, AML, CDD, Sanctions screening workflow system. It leverages Agentic AI to help to increase efficiency and accuracy

HSBC Technology, Pune (Oct 2011 to Feb 2023) Role/Designation: Project Manager/Lead Business Analyst

Defined program objectives, governance frameworks, and success metrics; steered multi-stream initiatives, managing risks, dependencies, and escalations to deliver enterprise-grade outcomes on schedule

Designed executive-level Power BI dashboards and interactive visualizations, transforming complex program data into actionable insights for C-suite decision making.

Orchestrated Agile Release Trains under SAFe, boosting sprint velocity and ensuring consistent delivery • Collaborated cross-functionally with UX, architects, developers, and QA to prioritize requirements across Cloud, Microservices, DevOps, Data Analytics, enabling faster delivery of enterprise-grade solutions.

Conducted quarterly Program Increment planning sessions, supporting the Agile Release Train coordination, fostering cross-team alignment, Translated Product roadmap into product backlogs, Epics, User stories

Major Projects Worked:

HSBC Ecare : HSBC Retail Banking

Platform that enables Customer care staff to resolve customer care issues and a chat bot to solve issues

HSBC Research Portal/Mobile App: MSS

Digitalizing business journeys in mobile app and Website for the Institutional clients for buy side recommendation reports on various asset classes like Equities, Bonds, Currencies and ESG

Global Trade Surveillance: HSBC MSS

Surveillance and reporting of insider trades, positions, market abuse, front running across all instrument types and trading. The platform monitors the business users and gives notifications, Alerts and BI reports

SB Wealth account: Standard Bank Wealth Management

Digital Wealth Management account for Retail customers that can be opened digitally also customer can choose from a wide range of Mutual funds, Insurance products and can see various visualization dashboards

Tieto Software Ltd (Oct 2009 to Oct 2011) Role – Business Analyst, Pune

Managed FRD/BRD, Requirement Analysis, checking Production issues, Testing defects and UAT support

Nihilent Technogies (Feb 06 to Oct 09) Role – System Analyst, Pune

Performed Business Analysis and production support tasks for various banking clients

Certifications SAFe5 Product Owner/Product Manager Certification conducted by National stock exchange of India (NCFM) in Financial Markets, Equity Derivatives, Commodities Derivatives, Currency Derivatives.

Education Post Graduate Diploma in Advance Computing from C-DAC, Pune Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology from Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Bhopal,India
